free_tier.stated: no free tier; Windows XL+ is USD 94.00/month, discounted to USD 60.00/month for three months on a one-year term

retention.stated: the disk persists for the contract term; the US page states a one-year term for the promotional rate

egress.terms: unlimited traffic up to 1 Gbit/s; no byte quota or rate is published

interface_detail: RDP over a public IPv4; IONOS has a Cloud API and control panel
tooling: any RDP client; IONOS Cloud API and control panel
chaining: 8 vCPU and 16 GiB for USD 60 a month for the first quarter, then USD 94, which makes it the cheapest first-quarter row and one of the most expensive steady-state rows

limits.value: the promotional rate runs for three months on a one-year term; the list rate is USD 94.00

limits_note: the UK page adds a GBP 10.00 setup fee and prints GBP 81.00 list against GBP 52.00 for three months; the US page prints no setup line
binding_note: the 1 Gbit/s port is the only hard ceiling; the traffic is unlimited without a published rate, and the term governs the price rather than the capacity.

identity_cost.detail: an account and a payment method at order; the checkout was not read

reliability_note: no reliability event observed; the vendor advertises 99.99%+ uptime
confidence_note: the shape, the list price, the three-month promotional price and the one-year term are printed on the US page read. The licence is included on the evidence of the identical Linux SKU being GBP 40.00 cheaper on the UK page; the page does not itemise it.

evidence.proved: quoted: 'Windows XL+ Save $102 $94 $60/month for 3 months with a 1-year term ... 8 vCores CPU ... 16 GB RAM ... 480 GB NVMe'
quoted: 'Windows XL+ Save GBP 97 GBP 81 GBP 52/month for 3 months excl. VAT Setup GBP 10 ... 8 vCores CPU ... 16 GB RAM ... 480 GB NVMe'
the identical Linux SKU is GBP 41.00 list and GBP 12.00 introductory, a GBP 40.00 gap against the Windows price that is consistent with a bundled licence

notes: The first-year average is USD 85.50: three months at USD 60.00 plus nine at USD 94.00. The steady-state bill is USD 94.00 from month 13, which is why the row ranks below the cheaper monthly rows despite the strongest first-quarter price.

extras.windows_licence: included; derived from the GBP 40.00 Linux-to-Windows gap
